name: arrayMap
description:
Calls the given closure with every element in the given array.
the function returns an array that contains all values returned by the closure.
syntax: arrayMap( array array, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
filter can be a function/closure that implements the following constructor

[function(any value[, number index, array array]):any].

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
